host.description: Remote host to retrieve URL from. Defaults to localhost if empty.

method.description: HTTP request method (e.g., GET, POST, PURGE).

http_version.description: HTTP version to use. Use '-' for HTTP/0.9.

extra_headers.description: List of extra headers to send. Each item is a header line (e.g., 'X-Custom: Value'). Newlines in the string will be interpreted as header separators.

if_modified_since.description: If-Modified-Since time in Epoch seconds. 0 disables this header.

use_tls.description: Use Transport Layer Security on the HTTP connection.

tls_cert_file.description: File containing client X.509 certificate in PEM format.

tls_ca_file.description: File containing trusted Certificate Authority (CA) certificates in PEM format.

ping_count.description: Ping mode iteration count. 0 loops until interrupted.

ping_interval.description: Ping interval in seconds. 0 uses default (1s).

local_bind.description: Local IP address to bind to.

timeout.description: Timeout value (seconds) for read/write operations. 0 uses default.

verbose.description: Verbose mode: Print outgoing message to stderr.

silent.description: Silent mode: Do not print data to stdout.

trace_count.description: Trace count HTTP relay or proxy hops. 0 disables tracing.
